name: rubato-opencode
description: Rubato (musical term: stolen time) model-state monitor for opencode: captures Estimate/Thinking/Generating/Done/Error states per model call via plugin hooks (token usage kept in the local archive), estimates duration locally (feature-based kNN), and publishes lean records to EMQX (rubato/<deviceId>/state) with derived clientId OC-TT-<mac6>.
